name: Google login and customer create edit retention
description: Signs in as the authorized owner, creates a customer, edits its business category, and verifies durable data.
steps: Sign in with the authorized Google account
Open the customer register and add a company with a lead source
Refresh the page and search for the company
expected: The edited company remains visible after refresh, and the business category matches the saved value.

name: One customer can have multiple loan cases
description: Creates a customer and two linked loan cases and confirms the customer remains counted once.
steps: Create a customer with a lead source
Create two SME Freedom cases linked to that company
Open the loan case list and dashboard
expected: Both cases show the same company, while the dashboard counts one customer and keeps case amounts in the case totals.

name: Contact history and follow-up remain linked
description: Adds a contact note and a due-today task for a linked case and verifies both in their sections.
steps: Create a customer and a linked SME Freedom case
Add a contact-history entry for the company and case
Add a follow-up task due today for the same case
Open contact history and follow-up tasks
expected: The contact entry and task appear under the selected company, and the task is counted as due today.

name: Protect linked records and export filtered data
description: Confirms a linked case cannot be removed accidentally, exports a CSV, and signs out.
steps: Create a company, a linked case, and a document record
Attempt to delete the linked case
Export the document list to CSV
expected: The linked case is preserved with a clear explanation, the CSV downloads without executable formulas, and the app returns to its login screen.
